items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Yeah, Frank Crump used to play alto. He died not long ago.

ctx.x: Put the light suit on too. Here's Henry Harden here. Oh, there's Henry Harden again, next to him.

This is Frank Crump. You ever heard talk of Frank Crump? I seem to have heard that name. Yeah, Frank Crump used to play alto. He died not long ago. Yeah. Here's Howard Davis. Playing the light suit, yeah. Uh-huh. And this fella here, I think, what his name, I meets him now. He plays clarinet. He's still with the clarinet, hmm? Yeah, he's still with him. Hmm. Hmm. You hear his hoods right here, the banjo. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
Last of them fellas, I haven't forgotten their name. Been so long. Yeah. Uh, this fella here on trumpet, he, uh, I knew him. He died, uh, last year. I knew him.
